added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs: gate.log records the after arm at revision ad415ded6 (dirty tree carrying the change) with 1 failure, tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py::test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window, EXIT=1; that failure is in reckon/roadmap.py, a file the diff does not touch (git diff --name-only ad415ded6..cee4634d6 | grep roadmap is empty), and the done_when declares it pre-existing on main, so the added set is empty. The reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite keys, so no base-arm log exists for this run; the baseline is taken as the same single pre-existing width failure.
call_sites: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1655 (reckon crew gc handler calling crew_module.garbage_collect)

findings.text: _run_directory_grace_seconds re-implements the "integer plus s/m/h unit to seconds" capability the repository already owns — reckon/crew/node.py:826 parse_duration (public, re-exported at reckon/crew.py:72) and reckon/flight.py:154-181 (_BUDGET_UNITS, budget_seconds) — declaring a third identical units table at gc.py:228 and hand-rolling the validity check at gc.py:311-315 instead of extending either owner.

_committed_review_exists duplicates the committed-review walk of reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:_committed_review_rounds (promotion_checks.py:2641-2678), which walks the same committed_review_root/COMMITTED_RUN_DIRNAME/<run_id>/*.json and reads carried_revision_pair for a carried head; gc could call that owner and test its heads set rather than re-implementing the loop.

the grace parser has no test — tests/test_only_a_run_something_can_still_need_keeps_its_directory.py never sets gc.directory_grace and no other test names _run_directory_grace_seconds — so the 3h to 10800 s conversion and the malformed-value fallback the manifest's evidence_inputs claims (manifest.md:16) are unverified by any recorded log or assertion.

the fragment asserts the unpromoted fixture is held by "the retention predicate" and that this "is what makes the declared mutation decisive", but the mutation that ran (gate-negative-control.log:26-31) prunes only live-run, queued-run and review-owed-run; the unpromoted fixture is excluded earlier by the unledgered-directory guard at gc.py:690, which the mutation does not remove, so the plan's named negative control is not demonstrated and the fragment's account of it is wrong.

_run_directory_grace_seconds(project) resolves the flight config without checkout_path while the sibling accessor run_file_limit_bytes in the same pass passes checkout_path=repo_root (reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:1110-1113), so a project-layer gc.directory_grace can be read from a different checkout than the repo being swept, silently ignoring the override.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the reviewed goal is "Retire a finished run's directory in gc's retention pass once nothing can still need the run"; the diff delivers it at reckon/crew/gc.py:683-790, where a directory is kept while a live pointer or queued entry (gc.py:692), an in-flight review (gc.py:699), a review owed (gc.py:705) or a stream-derived figure (gc.py:733) can still need it, then removed once past the configurable grace window.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when asks for a dry and a real pass over seven fixture states listing only the reviewed-old run, with each removal's path and size printed; tests/test_only_a_run_something_can_still_need_keeps_its_directory.py:196-275 carries every one of those assertions and the result is recorded, not merely claimed, in gate.log (139 passed, 1 pre-existing failure) and delivered-revision.log (3 passed).
VERDICT write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/crew/gc.py, reckon/schema/flight.yaml, reckon/_flight_schema.py, docs/_shared/flight.schema.json, the node's own test file, its evidence fragment and its figures directory; git show --stat over cee4634d6 touches exactly the first six paths and creates no figure, every path inside the scope and the declared figures path left unused deliberately.
VERDICT manifest: read at manifest.md:5-17; it states status complete, commits ["cee4634d6"], the gate command and two gate logs, and a negative-control log by absolute path, but it carries no baseline_suite or after_suite keys, so the added-failure accounting a promotion reads derives nothing for this run and the reviewer must fall back to the raw gate logs.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against ad415ded6; cee4634d6 adds the retention predicate and grace reader to reckon/crew/gc.py (167 lines), the directory_grace slot regenerated into the three schema artifacts, a 275-line test file and a 60-line evidence fragment, nothing outside the declared scope.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1655 (the `reckon crew gc` handler, calling crew_module.garbage_collect with apply and retention_days), reckon/crew.py:85 and reckon/crew/routing.py:3806 (re-exports of garbage_collect)

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/gc.py:683-790 keeps a finished run's directory on need (gc.py:692, :699, :705, :733) and removes it after the grace window at gc.py:668-670, exactly the behaviour §3 fixes.
SCORE evidence: 14
